p_col.note: Raw p-value column. Blank = auto-detect (adjusted columns are excluded — they would make λ meaningless).

band.note: Shade the 95% pointwise null band (Beta order statistics).

top_n.note: Most-extreme points listed in the Statistics table.

max_points.note: Plotted-point budget. The significant tail is kept whole; only the bulk is thinned. λ and n always use every p-value.

catalog.summary: Q-Q plot of observed vs expected -log10 p-values with the 95% null band and the inflation factor λ — the calibration check that shows whether a test is inflated, conservative, or honest. A volcano of an inflated test looks better, not worse; this is the figure that catches it.
